title: Satin Brass Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand - 49-Inch Solid Brass Bathroom Towel Stand, Soho Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels organized and drying neatly without drilling into your walls—this freestanding swing arm towel stand is backed by a limited lifetime warranty and designed for everyday bathroom use in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass.

  • Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
  • Coordinates beautifully with other Soho hardware in the same finish
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Protect floors and surfaces with a felt pad designed to prevent scratching
  • Choose a look that fits—available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Built from solid brass, this towel stand is made to outlast die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives while delivering corrosion-resistant, rust-free performance. Part of the Soho collection—a clean-lined, versatile option for matching Soho and other transitional bathroom hardware.

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Soho collection.

Specs

  • Product type: Freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel stand
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in x 49 in x 9.25 in
  • Diameter: 1 in
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Freestanding
  • Weight capacity: 20 lb
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Included: Towel stand
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
